title: Verify: buildSpriteSheet unit tests
summary: Unit tests for sheet size, frame count, frame placement, palette-only colours and errors.
description: Write tests from REQ2 acceptance criteria using small synthetic grids.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata, frame placement and palette-only colours are asserted.
Throws on bad input and identical bytes on repeat runs are asserted.
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; shared palette max 48 colours.

steps.action: Create the test file. Build 4 frames of 32x48 filled with indices 0..3 via Array.from. Assert width 128, height 48, frameWidth 32, frameHeight 48, frameCount 4, data.length 128*48*4. Assert the pixel at (k*32, 0) equals gridToRgba(frame k).data first 4 bytes for k 0..3.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts

steps.action: Add tests: every opaque pixel's colour is in PALETTE; [] throws; frames of 2x2 and 3x2 throw; a frame with index 99 throws; two builds of the same frames give toEqual data (identical bytes).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/spriteSheet.test.ts
